OPTIQON Voice uses accessibility to insert dictated text into text fields in other apps. It can read the content of the focused field, which it uses to place the dictation at the cursor. Password fields and banking apps are blocked from injection.
Text copied to clipboard
Enable accessibility service for direct text insertion
Optiqon Voice cannot run in a work profile

Android starts a dictation service only for the profile you are currently in, and a work profile never is. Anything you dictate here would be handled by the personal copy of Optiqon Voice instead — its microphone, its key, its history — without saying so. Use Optiqon Voice in your personal profile.
